programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The annual fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death come to Midsomer village Whitcombe Mallet. When the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson have to unravel a complex feud from the past, where nothing is what it seems...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton. Shortly before leaving their hotel they mention they haven't been able to find what they're looking for; "something old and derelict that they can do up." Anne Merrick tells them about Winyard, a tumbledown cottage in the woods, might be for sale. At the estate agents they are told the house is not yet available for viewing. Later that evening they find the house on their own. However, Caroline has read up on the cottage's haunted reputation and only reluctantly explores it with Peter. The next morning they are found strangled in their own car. DCI Barnaby starts the investigation with the help of PC Ben Jones and they come across the world of estate agents, identical twins, ghosts, piano wire, and more before another body turns up.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Midsomer Barton are all set to celebrate Oak Apple Week, especially as the carnival queen event is set to return after an eight year absence. Yet the body of the mother of a deceased, one-time carnival queen, found in a stream, looks set to spoil things, as Barnaby and Jones find themselves digging up the past. From familiar faces, to drunken boasts and hidden obessions, it slowly becomes clear that the mother's daughter might be the key to solving the murder, when more deaths follow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Wealthy, eccentric and obese aristocrat Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives at Haddington Hall to make an announcement. Although George Bullard is adamant his death is from natural causes, the case is far from simple when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in a house fire shortly afterwards and Freddy's will goes missing. Barnaby and Jones find themselves investigating the extended Butler family, uncovering hidden secrets, illegitimate children and elusive treasure in the process.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Martin Barrett, a local council clerk living in Midsomer Worthy, is murdered during the night by shotgun, prompting Barnaby and Jones to find a motive for his murder. When they discover that Barrett was an expert blackmailer, his victims become prime suspects for his death - from a local pub landlord, a cleaner, a prominent member of the police board, to a former marine geologist. As they investigate, finding themselves drawn to the seaside, they slowly uncover deception, theft, attempted blackmail and hatred.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Broughton, a ninety-year-old battle of the sexes has often occurred, with men trying to oppose an event that the women have managed to successfully hold without interruption, until it culminates with casualties on both sides - Mildred Danvers, an elderly woman who had returned on the day of a funeral and poisoned in her hotel room, and Rev. Anthony Gant, shot during a major event being held in the village green, in view of many. It soon becomes clear someone may have wished to kill both to cover up a dark truth, and soon Barnaby has to figure out who amongst the village wanted both dead, complicated further when Gant's curate is murdered next.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers in Elverton-cum-Latterly are up in arms and divided, over the building of a supermarket. Things soon come to a head when independent environmental supervisor, Frank Hopkirk, is found stabbed to death at a Jubb's Timber Yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate to determine who wanted Hopkirk dead, they find out that he secretly came to the village under various aliases for sexual rendezvous with various women in fantasy role-playing scenarios, and that he had been making further investigations on the future development site and having doubts over claims it was contaminated. Either someone didn't like his investigations, or someone didn't like his sexual appetite, but either way, Barnaby finds himself investigating lies and more to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and DC Ben Jones (Jason Hughes) find themselves attempting to unravel the deaths of a choir tenor, and later a bird watcher, before more murders occur. The case is complicated by a rivalry between the Midsomer Worthy and Aston Wherry choirs, due to compete in an upcoming competition, and suspicions that an art scam is to be conducted, and soon Barnaby and Jones become concerned about a local woman, who they fear may become a victim herself. Particularly when it becomes clear the bird watcher had been photographing suspicious activity of late.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A few months ago, Annie Woodrow was arrested, accused of murdering her friend, Frances Trevelyan, on the motive of wanting Frances' husband. Her time in court has come, but DCI Barnaby is certain she still is holding things back in regards to the murder, and decides to monitor the trial. Yet a chance remark by Frances' youngest daughter, and a meeting with an old friend and psychiatrist, makes him begin to doubt the evidence for her conviction. Soon he and DC Jones, awaiting news of his promotion to DS, find themselves reinvestigating the case, and it soon becomes clear that they may have missed details that could implicate another in the murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee at the Luxton Deeping Crime Festival is jeopardised when the manuscript is stolen and a woman is fatally electrocuted by a booby-trapped roulette wheel. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Could a ballad made famous by late, lamented folk singer Johnny Carver be an inspiration for murder? Did someone want to kill Toby Winning for threatening to take the Little Crosby Folk Festival away from Midsomer - or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The fizz goes out of a sparkling wine launch when the glasses are laced with slug poison. Who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery and what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: It's Christmas and new detective Charlie Nelson moves into Midsomer. He's thrown straight into an intriguing mystery in the village of Morton Shallows. A man is fatally stabbed with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at a "haunted" manor house. Can Barnaby and Nelson find a more earthly motive behind the murder and trap the killer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A series of murders in Midsomer St Claire seem to be inspired by macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt. As the village prepares for storms and flooding it appears that someone is using ancient torture methods to punish modern-day "sinners". But who is responsible and why?

programme.title: Local Knowledge

With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance.After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.sub-title: Rhine-Meuse Delta The Land of Canals
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies a unique biotope and a landscape characterised by water: the Rhine-Meuse Delta. Around a third of the Netherlands lies in the heart of Europe, below sea level, with 3,500 polders as a buffer for excess water and numerous cities crossed by canals. It is also a region where nature borders directly on cities, where intensive agriculture gradually leaves its place to the water, where the largest nature parks are in the immediate vicinity of Rotterdam's largest industrial port. From the sources of the Waal to the port of Rotterdam, we encounter protected plant, bird and mammal species, as well as the Delta inhabitants who have created this unique habitat.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: The journey leads through one of the most fascinating delta landscapes in the world. Starting in the untouched jungle of the Tumucumaque in the north of the Amazon delta, the journey continues south by boat across the 30 kilometre wide river to the Ilha de Maraj. The largest river island in the world, as large as Switzerland, is surrounded by wide beaches, mangrove forests and floodplain forests. On the island untouched jungle and wet savannah characterise the land. Fishermen and aai farmers live from the fruits of nature on the edge of the numerous river veins and flood plains and the collection of medicinal plants serves here, far away from civilization, as a living for the people. On the south side of the delta in the city of Belem we explore the exotic world of the famous Ver-o-Peso market with its impressive variety of fish, tropical fruits, spices and medicinal herbs.

programme.title: Beach Jackals
programme.desc: Through the eyes of researchers Ingrid Viesel and Eric Murray, the film explores all aspect of jackals lives: their dens behind the dunes, their litter, heir division of labor, their social interaction and communications. By following two different packs, the story delves into the complex dynamics of the individual jackals as they continually struggle for position and dominance.

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: Pilotos de Combate
programme.desc: Unos pilotos de la fuerza aérea investigan en una misión antidrogas y descubren a un mafioso que disfraza sus negocios.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: El pistolero del Diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre mata a su hijo, se vuelve alcohólico, pierde a su mujer, tiene alucinaciones y un pacto con el diablo.

programme.title: Matar por matar
programme.desc: La posesión de un revólver determina la vida y la muerte de quienes lo empuñan en un determinado momento.

programme.title: Veneno para las Hadas
programme.desc: Un par de amigas de 10 años, deciden preparar un veneno para las hadas, ya que una de ella se siente bruja.

programme.title: Tráiganlos vivos o muertos
programme.desc: Una mujer roba un banco mientras su cómplice y amante dispara a los banqueros protegiéndola en su huida.

programme.title: Jóvenes Delincuentes
programme.desc: Jóvenes se encuentran atrapados en un mundo de drogas y crímenes del que es casi imposible escapar.

programme.title: La Ley de las Calles
programme.desc: Después de cuatro años un hombre es liberado de la cárcel y al salir es atacado por los hermanos de su novia.

programme.title: El Día del Compadre
programme.desc: Durante la víspera del Día del Compadre, los habitantes de un condominio se preparan para festejar entre risas, juegos y riñas.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Visita al Pasado
programme.desc: Un grupo de niños que viaja a través del tiempo al siglo XVII hacen frente a un castillo embrujado.

programme.title: S.O.S. Conspiración Bikini
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de mujeres hermosas, una organización internacional de terroristas crean problemas en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: Elena y Raquel
programme.desc: Una joven está embarazada de un novio que la abandonó y odia al bebé, pero al nacer cambian sus sentimientos hacia el menor.

programme.title: La cárcel de Laredo
programme.desc: Un hombre poderoso separa a su hija del novio, un mecánico, y lo envía a la prisión, a pesar de que la joven está embarazada.

programme.title: Un ángel de la calle
programme.desc: Una madre se opone a que su hijo se case con una joven pobre. La falta de obediencia por parte del joven desata la desgracia.

programme.title: Tierra de violencia
programme.desc: El hijo de un comisario asesinado se encuentra en problemas cuando descubre que el pueblo ha sido estafado.

programme.title: Mi noche de bodas
programme.desc: En su noche de bodas, una joven humilde recién casada con un boticario recibe una pulsera de brillantes con una nota que pone en duda su honestidad, aunque ella jura y perjura su inocencia.

programme.title: Mi Ley es un Revólver
programme.desc: Un justiciero ayuda a la dueña de unos terrenos que podría ser despojada por un ranchero de una indemnización millonaria.

programme.title: Papá Lebonard
programme.desc: Con su gran sencillez y bondad, papá Leonard vence la hipocresía y los falsos valores de su esposa.

programme.title: La Conquista de El Dorado
programme.desc: Siete pistoleros viajan por el desierto y luchan por sobrevivir mientras buscan El Dorado.

programme.title: Plazos Traicioneros
programme.desc: Una joven mesera conoce a un ex productor de cine que acaba de salir de prisión y la hace estrella de cine.

programme.title: Sota, caballo y rey
programme.desc: Un bandido arma una intriga para convertirse en el dueño de un rancho, hasta que los hijos del dueño real lo descubren.

programme.title: La Perra
programme.desc: Una mujer quiere asesinar a su esposo, se va de vacaciones en barco con él y recibe la ayuda del capitán.

programme.title: Servicio Secreto
programme.desc: Las historias de tres policías que resuelven todos sus casos en forma cómica.

programme.title: Tú y la mentira
programme.desc: La esposa de un cantante se vuelve vedette e intenta engañarlo con un cantante venezolano, que resulta ser su amigo.

programme.title: División narcóticos
programme.desc: Unos traficantes obligan a los campesinos de la frontera a sembrar amapola y amenazan de muerte a quién se niegue.

programme.title: Manos de Seda
programme.desc: Tres mujeres aman a un delincuente apodado "Manos de Seda", ya que él las sacó de diversos apuros.

programme.title: El Barro Humano
programme.desc: Un hombre ha herido a su esposa y en el juicio se niega a defenderse, esto obliga a reconstruir los hechos con testigos.

programme.title: Suicídate mi amor

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How Paleo-Indian culture began to diversify regionally; understanding why some groups developed a hunting and gathering culture, while others fished from temporary camps; what DNA research reveals about one ancient sedentary people.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How the creative yet disparate peoples of North America developed innovations such as corn agriculture, permanent houses and religion about 5,000 years ago; exploring the only innovation common to these many different cultures.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.sub-title: Poverty Point: North America's First City
programme.desc: How a group of ancient people developed a planned community on more than 900 acres of land to accommodate 4,000 to 5,000 inhabitants; how the city of Poverty Point functioned for 1,000 years and included one of the world's oldest pyramids.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.sub-title: Medicine Wheels of the Great Plains
programme.desc: Surveying what is known about medicine wheels, which are wagon-wheel type arrangements of stones on the ground that vary in their number of spokes and size; learning their functions and meaning, which almost certainly changed over time.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.sub-title: Adena Culture and the Early Woodlands Period
programme.desc: The evolution of the continent's first coherent civilizations in Ohio about 3,000 years ago; studying the Adena, the first ancient American culture with a wide-ranging influence; the Adena's conical burial mounds and shared concept of an afterlife.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.sub-title: Native America: A Story of Survival
programme.desc: The commonly held views of Native Americans and the realities of a tapestry of vibrant cultures; Cobb explains the pitfalls that occur when history does not provide this crucial viewpoint; the mistake of consigning Native Americans to the past.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.sub-title: The Columbian Exchange: New Worlds for All
programme.desc: The misleading dichotomy of Old World and New World impacts perceptions of Native Americans; the Columbian Exchange is the crux behind the creation of new worlds for all; shaping everything from the fauna and flora to the cuisines of the world.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.sub-title: The Native South and Southwest in the 1600s
programme.desc: The cultures that exist before the Spanish Invasion; the struggle for power through Hernando de Soto's entrada through the Southeast; the Pueblo War for Independence in the Southwest; the Native American worlds born in the aftermath of these events.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: How connections are forged between Native Americans and newcomers as they incorporate each other into their worlds; examples across the Northeastern Woodlands down to Werowocomoco; how the search for common ground begins at first contact.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: Once Europeans arrive, the Native peoples of the Northeast want to maintain their autonomy; the strategies and experiences of the Wendat and Iroquois; Native Americans transform the European colonial project while preserving a measured separatism.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: An exploration of the Iroquois Confederacy and the Lenape people; Native Americans keep or lose their lands through treaties and negotiations; the repercussions of these conflicts sometimes go beyond relocation, enslavement or near annihilation.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.sub-title: The Seven Years' War in Indian Country
programme.desc: The French and Indian War is portrayed in history as a turning point for Native nations in the East; for some, it serves as a victory, for others, a defeat; a changed storyline; the perspectives of Native people who experience the era differently.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.sub-title: The American Revolution through Native Eyes
programme.desc: The Native Americans experience the American Revolution as allies, as participants in their own civil wars and as neutral parties; for many, the resolution of the American Revolution holds little meaning; the rule of the colonists or the Crown.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: In 1492, Europe is dwarfed in power by the civilizations of China, India, the Ottomans of the Middle East and even the empires of Africa; the modern nation-state, capitalism, Christianity and new technologies combine to catapult Portugal.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither villain nor visionary, Christopher Columbus is an extremely learned and devout man; he embarks on his enterprise of the Indies for gold, glory and gospel; he dies unaware that he has initiated arguably the most important event in history.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.sub-title: Stepping Stones-The Conquest of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Within a generation, the Spanish sweep across the Caribbean Sea and the surrounding regions, conquering and annihilating native peoples, establishing the patterns of conquest that they repeat across the Americas for nearly a century.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: In the conquest of Mexico, two empires collide; two mighty figures clash; Hernan Cortes leads a renegade Spanish expedition to the coast of Mexico; he exploits divisions among the various Indian tribes, capturing Montezuma in his own palace.

programme.title: America's Founding Fathers
